steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Team battle?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's a two on two, a rather uncommon competition format. Originally, to showcase the teamwork within the Knightclubs, it should've been at least three on three or four on four.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No matter the format, you don't have a Knightclub, so we need to find you a partner.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... Who am I up against?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The competition schedule says it's the Snowyheel Knightclub.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...They have some decent archers, and even one knight that uses meteor hammers. I don't know who you'll end up against.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maria's finally reached the point where we'll know her opponents by name alone, huh.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha......

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I don't know if that's a good thing or a bad thing...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maria, defeating Tytus is definitely something worth celebrating, but it also means that there will be a lot more eyes on you.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Draw on the lessons you learned from Flametail and Ashlock. Don't tip your hand.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It's important to compromise and work with the corporations when you have to. Times have changed. You can't hold onto your glory with wins alone.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Why didn't you help me convince her last time?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I did have a proper conversation with Maria after you slammed the door——By the way, you broke my door that time.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ugh. I'll cover it...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Where's V and Kowal?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It's 'that day.' They're not back yet.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ah... They're at the gravesite. Shit, I wanted to ask if he could help repair Maria's equipment...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Just use his workshop.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: He even said so himself, one time last year, drunkenly. If you ever wanted to, Maria, he would gladly pass on his workshop to you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh?! Why haven't I this before?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Either way, he's still sworn to never touch the anvil again.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*... Even after so many years...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It's hard enough for anyone to let go of the past, let alone us oldies who have nothing but the past.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Lets forget about them for now. Maria, you'll need to fix up your equipment yourself.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And then... Do you have a partner in mind?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Me? Umm...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: D-Do I actually not have any knight friends?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's why I wanted to introduce you to someone. A known quantity is always safer than getting a random stranger assigned by the Association.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Err, who is it?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Fartooth Knight. She's an expert archer.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Just like you, she fought her way up as an independent knight, refusing to accept sponsorships from the corporations. I've heard she's even planning to form a completely self-sufficient knightclub.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I think you'll be able to get along, and cover each other's weaknesses in battle. You'll come to understand that team battles are completely different from melees or one-on-ones.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If only we had more time, you could get to know each other better on the training field. Unfortunately, you'll have to improvise.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...O-okay.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: This is the disadvantage of being an independent knight... Temporary allies fighting against a battle-hardened team will always be at a disadvantage.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I wonder what she's like... I'm a little nervous...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: This is our third time passing this street today.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah, yes, Mr. Czarny...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You're very accustomed to such work. Running between the various arenas and joining in countless teleconferences.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah, no... There's nothing to be said for someone like me...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Your appearance is somewhat sloppy. One's appearance is also an important bargaining chip, is it not?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: A-Apologies... To be honest, I was unemployed not too long ago... So...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Oh... What has that got to do with this?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I don't dislike employees like you. Only those who have fallen to rock bottom are able to understand the cruelty we face. It is only when you have acknowledged it, that you will be able to make satisfactory decisions.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Remember each and every word I have said, each and every action I have taken.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Eh? Ah, the meeting minutes for the Snowyheel Knightclub? Don't worry, I've prepared——

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No no no, their sponsor is an old friend of mine. They won't trouble us much.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It's just for a particularly insignificant...working habit of mine.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You know I never approved of you becoming a competition knight, not since the beginning.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh, huh? Where did that come from? I knew that already...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But you've proven yourself.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Though it was always by the skin of my teeth...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Rather than your motivations, platitudes, promises or whatnot... Winning in the arena is the only proof of your determination.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Even though you're still very naive.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha......

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maybe...it's your desire to win back the glory of the Nearl family that makes you so strong.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ——Though it was just a fluke, being able to take a point off Tytus means your upcoming opponents should be manageable.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You've developed your own Arts techniques, but it doesn't seem to work against particularly strong opponents, unfortunately.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: For example, if the Left-hand Knight had fought seriously from the start, you would've probably lost even if there were four of you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I can teach you swordsmanship and tactics, and you can ask V about archery techniques. He may not look it, but back in the day V was an expert your granddad respected.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ——But when it comes to Arts, you are the only one who can grasp your light.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Got it?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes... Even though there were unexpected incidents, our plans are progressing on schedule.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: What? No, you're overestimating our clients. There will definitely not be any condemnation from the audience. They're not a particularly moral bunch.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes, you're right. I am very thankful for the two... helpers you've provided me.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I will ensure that they all receive an excellent report.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Bless you, sir.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...And now, everything is ready.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Let us await the beginning of this remarkable competition.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh... you're back.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Didn't they promise no rain? Why'd it still end up raining...?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hmph... You really can't believe all that crap they put on TV, whether it's news, sports or weather forecasts.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What about Maria! Ain't the competition today?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I've got food and wine for the both of you.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: How was it?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Whaddya mean how was it? It's been so long... There's a few less this year too.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Always less of us to visit the captain's grave.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: *Sigh*... She said she'd challenge me to a drinking contest, but she left before the booze was even poured.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Forget it, it's all in the past.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Yeah... Who'd have expected that the two of you really stayed single your entire lives for her sake.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Stop twisting the knife. Out with the wine!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That's right! Enough talk about who's still alive and who's not. We're here to enjoy Maria's performance!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Cheers, Kowal!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Cheers! V!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Here's a great bargain for today, self-service for all drinks. Help me watch the joint.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Oh? Is it free?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: In your dreams.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Where're you going?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The arena.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Huh? You got ahold of a ticket?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...I got someone to get me one. Tickets nowadays are so overpriced.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That's called business.

steps.name: Newsboy
steps.text: Good day, sir. Here's the midday sports news.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Thanks, kid. Have some milk.

steps.name: Newsboy
steps.text: Nice! Thank you, sir!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The midday sports news, huh——

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ——Wait, what's this?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome! Welcommme, one and allllll, to the Fireblade Arena!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The previous match just ended, and the blood of the 'Softwind' Knight still stains the ground. But that's just seasoning for the next battle!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No doubt, everybody's here today to witness the splendor of Nearl——! This lassie here may yet be young, but she's already done miracles before our very eyes!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We'll have an extra short break. In just ten minutes the temporary duo of Maria Nearl and the Fartooth Knight will——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Go against this year's rookies——The alliance of vengeance formed by elites of past years who've failed to enter the Major——The Snowyheel Knightclub!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A brand new legend versus the blade of vengeance, in an all-new two-on-two point match. What an unbelievably thrilling sight! The match shall begin soooon!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, your wounds?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Right! They're much better now! It's all thanks to you taking care of me!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright, I believe you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmm, she's late... Fartooth has always been bad with time.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It doesn't matter, as long as she makes it here before the match——

steps.name: Arena Worker
steps.text: Miss Maria! Miss Maria Nearl! Please head over to the waiting room and get ready! We're about to begin!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah. It's about to begin...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'd better get going, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...Zofia? Where's Maria?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Marcin? Why're you here?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh... I get it. You're still waiting for the Fartooth Knight.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She's not coming.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ——What?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Here, the sports page.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmm... The Fartooth Knight... seriously injured?!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She got dragged into a fight between knight fans and is now MIA.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: At least, that's what the paper says.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wait...she got dragged into a fight?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: This must be fake. What kind of fan violence can cause a battle-hardened knight to 'disappear'?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Wait... could it be...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Right now, the question is what do we do for the match?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Something is wrong, Zofia. Just think about it.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria has to forfeit! We're out of time, follow me——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No rest for the wicked, eh——What? You still think we're letting them rest too much? Come on, we've got to at least act like we're clearing up the battlefield, alright?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: How many of you are here for Nearl?! How many of you want to see the lovely Nearl?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Speaking for myself here, as someone who's followed every step this super rookie has taken, I've personally watched this prize pool grow to the king's ransom it is today!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let's look at the numbers! Right here, right now, in every city, every village in the country, the crowd watching this fight is in the hundreds of thousands!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Who do we have to thank for this?! I'm sure we all know!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But! I have some tragic news. The Fartooth Knight suffered heavy injuries in the incident last night and remains missing!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even so! Maria did not choose to forfeit! She steps into a two on one fight completely undeterred!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let me see how much her bravery means to each and every one of you!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Presenting——The hottest rookie of this season! Nearl's little knight, Maria Nearl!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh no, is she not here yet? What should I do...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...No, I can't give up easily. To give up before I've even begun is to disrespect knighthood!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Knighthood...yes, knighthood.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And on the other side! Two veterans of the Snowyheel Knightclub!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Back in their old Knightclubs, they failed to make it into the Major two seasons in a row. Looking for a way out, they finally ended up together in this Knightclub of vengeance!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The two members of the Snowyheel Knightclub here today are also well-known knights! They are——
A sudden deafening sound interrupts the announcer.

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Wait, what's this? Am I seeing things?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: N-no, there's a weird smell, it's really gross——

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: What's happening?!
Heavy footsteps resound within the twenty thousand seat arena.
As people regain their senses, the entire place remains silent.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ...Ugh.

A rare occurance in the world of knight sports. In a place that should be packed with vivacious enjoyment, tens of thousands of tourists and spectators hold their breaths, as if listening for the source of the footsteps.
The first to grasp it are VIPs on the grandstand, themselves knights.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Is that fog on the field? Originium Arts? Or some special equipment?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Is there anyone like that in the Snowyheel Knightclub... hmm...?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...No. Not them. It can't be them.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: That's——

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: ...Those are, ugh, knights?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ——Kowal!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I know! I know! Let's go!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That thing... They're trying to kill Maria!

steps.name: Shadow in the Darkness
steps.text: Miss, all teams are in position.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't be so nervous. We're here to stop anyone from coming into the arena.

steps.name: Shadow in the Darkness
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Shadow in the Darkness
steps.text: But if we have to stop——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If that Młynar dares try anything... I'll deal with him.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Even though it'll be a huge pain... *Sigh*.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ugh, so these are the Snowyheel Knightclub's...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Hey! What's going on? The deal for the day was——what? Huh? I can't figure out which of them is——)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ...The Snowyheel Knightclub's——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The 'Corrupted' and 'Withered' Knights!
The expected cheering does not materialize, as silence envelops the audience.
Naturally, the first thought in their minds is that of terror.
However, they soon come to realize that this terror is not for themselves, seated in the audience, but for the young girl who has not yet understood her situation.
This cruelty brings about a striking round of applause.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: This... Isn't this too scary?

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: ...Nearl is going to fight these two all by herself?

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hey... Isn't this going to be an amazing show?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Alright, then let's start the ma——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What——

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Target hit.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: ——Guh!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Why so... ugh?!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh... Shield, very durable. Not easy.

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: No matter... Kill her, not difficult.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: T-They're already exchanging lightning-fast blows before the match has even started! Is this a problem? Of course not! In fact, the match started the moment the knights stepped onto the field!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Can Nearl turn this around?! Or will she choose to forfeit early——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (What? Not allowed to forfeit...? This... urgh, fine.)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ——Within each of your hands lies the only way to turn the tide! Invest your money in the pitiful Maria! Maybe those simple little toys will be her key to victory!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh... This fog... What is it?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: My Arts are being suppressed...? My wounds, I can't heal them...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Agh... ouch...

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Target... Losing ability to resist. Kill her, quickly, like an accident.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Understood...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (No, don't even think of giving up, think of a way to——)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (These two Sarkaz...are twins? Their Arts are almost the exact same——!)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Then... let's try again!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Eh?)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: T-This is unbelievable! What just happened?! There was a sudden explosion on Maria's body, and the Corrupted Knight followed up with a hit that sent her flying!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Was that Withered? Corrupted? Does it matter anymore?)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnng——!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*... *cough*.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Blood...? Why... why aren't my Arts working?

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: She is vomiting blood... the Arts have taken effect.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: ...Fester, wither, decay... I can smell her death. She cannot escape.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! Forfeit the match! Quickly!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Tsk——

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let me go! Marcin!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Do you want to die with her?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Mph——

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ——Dying together is better than Maria dying alone!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hurry up, Kowal!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: D-Don't run so fast. I'm not a Kuranta——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Sorry, you're not allowed back here.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Former level-2 campaign knight, Vogelweide. Or should I say, Batbayar.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Your bloodline had you fighting all over the world. You got to run and howl across the prairies of no-man's-land.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: And you, senior craftsman of the Craftsman's Guild, Kowal.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Your master was a great blacksmith, respected by the Silverlance Pegasus, and your apprentices are still out there on the front lines even today——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You're both fine, upstanding Kazimierz citizens. Could you just, like, leave?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...The way you talk ain't nothing like that lil' girl I once met, Platinum.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm. You know?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Yes, we know. Of course we know.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: We have a personal grudge with some of your bosses.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Ah, so that's how it is.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I heard that the last Platinum's first job was to assassinate a campaign knight. A really pretty lady, named——

steps.name: Old Knight & Old Craftsman
steps.text: ——Shut up.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Funny. Another leader dying for a woman, in the end.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Maybe working this job too long really does screw with your head. *Sigh* I gotta take a vacation, go traveling...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Stop wasting time with this crap! Are you the ones messing around with Maria?!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Keep watching the perimeter. I'll deal with this.

steps.name: Voice in the darkness
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: So you have helpers after all. Why not call them out?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I really don't want to fight you. Can we not just take a step backwards?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hah! That's funny. An assassin of the Armorless Union has a soft heart?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Don't worry, I won't go all out against a young lass like you. When you've given up, we'll be off to rescue Maria——

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I... I'm fine. Just a scratch. I just didn't expect her to draw her bow that quickly and accurately...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yeah, she's done talking. She might be young and immature——

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: But she's still above the dregs of the Armorless Union, as the Platinum in that 'one-two-three inverted triangle' of theirs.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Umm... I'll take that as a compliment?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Get ready, Kowal. Let's see if you've still got it.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hah! I've long suspected that you're half-blind now, V.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Alright, alright. To you two feisty olds——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ——Don't sprain your backs.
Are you leaving now?
Yes, time is tight.
Then... Please be careful. Please, please be very careful.
Don't worry so much... She's still with you, right?
...Yes.
Don't worry, it's fine. I swear——knight's honor.
Y-You don't need to do that. Go on, I believe in you.
Good.
Have a safe journey.
Yes, thank you, Liz.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*... *cough*.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (My wounds are rotting, I can't heal them...! Losing blood... It's cold...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Faster than Mr. Szewczyk... Bigger than Mr. Ingra...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: These two——
Should I forfeit?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No, just hold on, I can still——

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: ...Hit. She should have fainted. You, go.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh... Boring fight... Just smash her head in.

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Go, quickly!
...The Sarkaz raises his weapon up high.
The sun shines brightly on the girl trying to regain her balance.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh, *cough*...
The blood on the ground, the metallic taste in her mouth, ears buzzing, head spinning, the fragrance of dirt after rain.
She tries to support her body with her hands, but gives in to the intense pain.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Old wounds... Hands...!)

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh... It's over.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnng...
Maria lies on the ground, unmoving. This sorrowful scene is reflected in the Sarkaz knight's emotionless eyes.
Suddenly, her vision brightens.
Perhaps the clouds blocking out the sun have dissipated, or perhaps the angle of the sunlight just happened to pass through the building's shade.
The next moment——He hears a thunderous sound. All the cells in his body are warning him, telling him that he must act immediately, that he must strike this defenseless little knight——
His vision brightens even more.
At the same time, the warhammer in his hand flies off, knocked away by someone.
